chunks.en: Imagine because of certain mysterious aspects of human existence, spirits, gods, and supernatural forces. So men conceive of a reality. So religion is men conceiving of a reality, not psych of themselves. Because there are things in human existence that you don't understand, mysterious. And because you don't understand it, you create spirits, gods, and supernatural forces. So it makes certain assumptions.
chunks.zh: 想象由于人类存在的某些神秘方面，存在着灵魂、神灵和超自然力量。因此人们构想出一种现实。因此，宗教是人们构想出的现实，而不是他们自己的心理。因为人类存在中有些事情你无法理解，非常神秘。正因为你不理解，所以你创造了灵魂、神灵和超自然力量。因此它会做出某些假设。

chunks.en: And these assumptions remind you, if you study for quite a while, people say, that's why we don't accept a Pilarian approach. Because it makes assumptions that people think are wrong. Now people say, these assumptions may actually be correct. Why do we create worlds to deal with a mysterious? Because he says, men's thinking is immature. It's almost the argument that they have. And actually many of the theories argue this.
chunks.zh: 这些假设提醒你，如果你学习一段时间，人们会说，这就是为什么我们不接受Pilarian方法。因为它做出了人们认为错误的假设。现在人们说，这些假设可能实际上是正确的。我们为什么要创造世界来处理神秘的事物？因为他说，人类的思维不成熟。这几乎就是他们的论点。实际上，许多理论也在争论这一点。

chunks.en: Which again, now in neurological study, we all know that it is wrong. But the argument has always been, including Mary and including Mullah, they argue that there were two kinds of brains. One is called the primitive brain. Remember, we're going back in time. We're going to, why people have religion. And so you go back all the way to little tribal groups who live in forests and who have no technology and so forth. And what was their brain like?
chunks.zh: 再次强调，现在在神经科学研究中，我们都知道这是错误的。但一直以来的争论，包括Mary和Mullah，他们认为有两种大脑。一种叫做原始大脑。记住，我们要回到过去。我们要探讨为什么人类会有宗教。所以我们回到那些生活在森林里、没有技术的小部落群体。他们的大脑是怎样的呢？

chunks.en: So some theories, which are all neurological studies prove that it is wrong, is that you have a primitive brain. And the argument there is why supposedly their argument, evolutionary theory of religion, increasingly we should not have religion. And that's what Tyler argues. Increasingly religion must be replaced by science. Why should it be replaced? Of course, we know that is also not true. Religion has not been replaced by science.
chunks.zh: 所以一些理论，所有神经学研究都证明这是错误的，是认为你有一个原始的大脑。而他们的论点是，据说他们的论点，宗教的进化理论，逐渐地我们不应该有宗教。这就是泰勒所争论的。宗教必须逐渐被科学取代。为什么它应该被取代？当然，我们知道这也不是真的。宗教并没有被科学取代。

chunks.en: Lots of religion over the world and lots of people who believe in religion. And they're all supposedly, quote unquote, modern men. Yes? You can't make some substance. They're arguing that there is a primitive brain. People say you measure brain size. Brain size doesn't change. Human, homo sapiens sapiens were successful, survival, combat to them, their hormone, their dental, this and the chromatin men. To argue that we are more intelligent than that.
chunks.zh: 世界上有许多宗教，也有许多信仰宗教的人。他们都被认为是所谓的“现代人”。是吗？你无法创造出某种实体。他们在争论说存在原始的大脑。人们说你可以测量大脑的大小。大脑大小不会改变。智人（Homo sapiens sapiens）之所以成功，是因为生存、战斗能力、激素、牙齿以及染色质等方面。他们争论说我们比那时更聪明。

chunks.en: So there have been at least seven, eight human existences. At least seven, eight. We were discovering more and more. Now, I did further my research. And so we are what we call homo sapiens sapiens. Let's ask human men, homo sapiens sapiens, who sapiens? Because it's our three-year existence. Under homo, homo sapiens. There are some of them. There are some of them. There are some of them. There are the denisovans. The denisovans are very important because they're
chunks.zh: 所以至少已经有七到八个人类存在。至少七到八个。我们正在发现越来越多。现在，我进一步进行了研究。所以我们是所谓的智人。让我们问人类，智人，谁是智人？因为这是我们三年的存在。在智人之下，有一些他们。有一些他们。有一些他们。有丹尼索瓦人。丹尼索瓦人很重要，因为他们

chunks.en: discovering that most ancient sapiens, the denisovani blood, has been intermarried with that. We have a lot of them. They have dimensions. Of course, we can use the denisovans. They have all disappeared. The denisovans don't exist anymore. The co-magnetism doesn't exist anymore. The homo sapiens don't exist anymore. There's a very big type of human weakness. We call it human weakness. And then in half of the year, we actually think they're still exist.
chunks.zh: 发现大多数古代智人，也就是丹尼索瓦人的血脉，已经与其他人通婚了。我们有很多他们的血统。他们有不同的维度。当然，我们可以使用丹尼索瓦人。他们已经全部消失了。丹尼索瓦人不再存在。共同磁性也不复存在。智人也不存在了。人类有一种非常大的弱点。我们称之为人类弱点。然后在半年内，我们实际上认为他们还存在。

chunks.en: But that type of people have also disappeared. Especially the mentalists. They look at all this family tree of men. You find all these different tribes, a difference or more. What's the argument? They are not as smart as us. So they have even more primitive brain than us. Then the studies show they actually have a bigger brain than us. So if you say how intelligent you are and based on the size of your brain, the mentalists have a bigger brain. So there is no scientific basis
chunks.zh: 但这类人也已经消失了。尤其是心灵主义者。他们看了所有这些男性家谱。你会发现各种不同的部落，有差异甚至更多。这有什么理由？他们不如我们聪明。所以他们的大脑比我们更原始。然后研究显示他们的大脑实际上比我们大。所以如果你说你有多聪明，基于大脑大小，心灵主义者的大脑更大。所以没有科学依据

chunks.en: for the argument that there were two kinds of brain. But the early social scientists argued that there were two kinds of brain. The primitive mind and the modern mind. And religion is a creation of the primitive mind. And in society as we progress and we evolve, we will finally be overcome by science. And so religion, according to Kyler, is the outcome of a immature mind. Again, as I said, the logic is that if we have modern mind, we should not have religion.
chunks.zh: 关于有两种大脑的论点。但早期的社会科学家认为有两种大脑。原始思维和现代思维。宗教是原始思维的产物。随着社会的发展和我们进化，我们最终将被科学所战胜。因此，根据凯勒的观点，宗教是不成熟思维的结果。再次如我所说，逻辑是如果我们拥有现代思维，我们就不应该有宗教。

chunks.en: All of us have a modern mind, but we still have religion. And therefore, this idea that there is a primitive mind is wrong, but H.A.B.B.D argues that no, no, we do not have a primitive mind, but our mind evolved in such a way to deal with the nature in a way that that instinctive dealing with nature continued to exist until last. And that instinctive way to deal with nature is the basis of religion. I'll come to that later. So what we have here now, this is important,
chunks.zh: 我们所有人都有现代思维，但我们仍然有宗教。因此，认为存在原始思维的观点是错误的，但H.A.B.B.D认为，不，不，我们没有原始思维，而是我们的思维以某种方式进化，以应对自然，这种本能地应对自然的方式一直延续到最后。而这种本能地处理自然的方式是宗教的基础。我稍后会讲到这一点。所以我们现在所拥有的，这一点很重要，

chunks.en: men's thinking is immature and we're all very emotional. So religion is primitive and will be overcome by science. And religion are speculations. It's originally inspected. What's up in the mind about dreams, about transits, and most importantly about them. The assumption here is important. I tend to be putting in a very negative way. It is not. You can't think of it as negative. It is not negative or positive. It's just simply an attempt to explain something.
chunks.zh: 男性的思维还很幼稚，我们都很情绪化。所以宗教很原始，会被科学克服。而宗教是推测。它最初是被审视的。关于梦境、过境，最重要的是，他们脑海里在想什么。这里的假设很重要。我倾向于用非常消极的方式表达。事实并非如此。你不能把它看作负面的。它既不是消极的，也不是积极的。它只是试图解释某些事情。

chunks.en: And so it is not primitive or not wrong in the sense that what is religion? It is man logically, rationally. These two words are important. I present religion as, oh, I'll come over, immature mind is primitive and will be replaced by science and so forth, and it's all speculation. But if you think about it from a Kylerian perspective, the argument is that religion exists because we observe. It's rational. Why are there, why do I dream of dead ancestors?
chunks.zh: 因此，它并不是原始的，也不是错误的，从宗教是什么的意义上来说？它是人类的，是逻辑的，是理性的。这两个词很重要。我把宗教呈现为，哦，我会说，未成熟的心智是原始的，并且会被科学等取代，这都是猜测。但如果你从一个凯勒的角度思考，论点是宗教存在是因为我们观察到的。它是理性的。为什么会有，为什么我会梦到已故的祖先？

chunks.en: Well, if I dream of dead ancestors, they must exist. There's a whole industry today in modern society that deals with trying to connect with the dead, right? There's a whole industry in the world today in trying to connect with the gods. There's one group which is going to study the Rick Swastika Society. It's still a modern attempt to connect with the gods, right? That's what option-hailing is. Option-hailing is an attempt to connect with the spiritual world.
chunks.zh: 好吧，如果我梦见死去的祖先，那他们一定存在。今天现代社会有一个完整的行业专门处理试图与死者沟通，对吗？如今世界上有一个完整的行业专门试图与神灵沟通。有一个团体将研究里克·万字符协会。这仍然是现代尝试与神灵沟通，对吗？这就是“选项召唤”。“选项召唤”是试图与灵界沟通的一种方式。

chunks.en: So it is actually a rational. If you think about it, it's rational, right? Because of religion, it is logical.
chunks.zh: 所以它实际上是合理的。如果你仔细想想，它是合理的，对吧？因为宗教，它是合乎逻辑的。
